sections.name: Product
sections.scope: Portal reads from the web surface.

sections.name: Support

stats.label: Shipped
stats.counted: counted as pull requests merged into main inside the window

stats.label: Median time to merge
stats.counted: counted from the first commit pushed to the merge, drafts included

stats.label: Reverted
stats.counted: counted as merges in the window whose title begins Revert, against one the week before

stats.label: Open past a week
stats.counted: counted as open pull requests, drafts left out, whose first commit is over seven days old

stats.label: Net cash flow
stats.counted: counted as the QuickBooks cash-basis result for the week, a surplus because Simple Casual paid a $60,000 invoice and Mercury treasury paid $92,492.84 of dividends

stats.label: Monthly recurring revenue
stats.counted: counted as active Stripe subscriptions priced by the month, the only place revenue lives; Stripe holds none and no payment since 1 June

stats.label: Model spend
stats.counted: counted as the Anthropic, OpenAI and OpenRouter rows in the ledger, a subset of outflow rather than an addition to the surplus

stats.label: Sign-ins
stats.counted: counted as sessions that reached the portal, one per member per day

stats.label: Apps opened
stats.counted: counted as app pages a member opened, repeat opens in one session left out

stats.label: Sites published
stats.counted: counted as site builds that finished and answered on their host

stats.label: Opened
stats.counted: would count conversations a customer started in the period

stats.label: Median first reply
stats.counted: would count from a customer's first message to the first reply from us

asks.title: Name where support happens
asks.body: Slack is connected here; Zendesk and Intercom are not. Name the channel or the shared inbox customers write to and the support set turns on.

asks.title: Say what each vendor is
asks.body: Burn splits by payee, so payroll, models and one-offs are separable. Nothing in the ledger says which vendor is infrastructure and which is people.

asks.title: Start billing customers
asks.body: Stripe holds no subscription and no payment since 1 June, so recurring revenue reads zero rather than unknown. It moves the week the flat-fee plans bill.

asks.title: Decide what a fix is
asks.body: Reverted counts merges whose title begins Revert. Name the labels that mark a fix and the count reads the label instead of the title.
